verdict.rationale: Firebase runs event-driven automations through Cloud Functions, so this axis applies. However, the evidence only shows one-command deployment and local emulator testing. Nothing documents versioning, review or approval, or rollback of deployed functions or automations. Code-based deploys that a user could track in their own source control are a user-side workaround and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
